structured.answer: The page says to hold it at Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך), in the fund "ילין לפידות קרן מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". Putting in 750 ₪ a month for 15 years (135,000 ₪ in total) leaves about 179,889 ₪ in today's money after fees and tax. It counts inflation at 2% a year and the return at 7% a year.

stuck.why: The 2% only showed after pressing the 'אינפלציה' button; the main screen only said 'בכסף של היום'
The box said 750 but the slider showed 800, so I wasn't sure which one was used

used: Input boxes סכום היום / הפקדה חודשית / שנים
Result card 179,889 ₪ 'נשאר לכם בעוד 15 שנים... בכסף של היום'
Account card פסגות ניירות ערך and fund card ילין לפידות
skimmed: Cost bar chart 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־15 שנים'
skipped: Fund filter chips (קרן מחקה, צוברת, עסקת החלף...)
not_found: Plain statement of the inflation assumption on the main screen

findings.what: Inflation rate is hidden behind a button; the main screen only says 'בכסף של היום' without the rate
Dark background with small grey text is hard to read
findings.where: Whole page, especially the lines under the results

findings.what: Slider shows 800 while the box shows 750
Red minus sign '−122 ₪' is alarming, though it's only a small difference
Many unexplained terms and English letters
Return of 7% is already filled in, with nothing saying it isn't guaranteed
